facts: The four objects differ in their carbon skeleton; their response ordering is not supplied as an experimental fact.
The defined quantity is the molecular response under isotropic orientational averaging in the static limit.
measurement_definitions: β_HRS(0;0,0)=sqrt(<β_ZZZ²>+<β_XZZ²>), where brackets denote an isotropic average over molecular orientations and laboratory polarization axes are stated. A single molecular Cartesian component is not this observable.
If reporting the depolarization ratio, define DR=<β_ZZZ²>/<β_XZZ²> and treat a vanishing denominator explicitly.
Specify the hyperpolarizability derivative convention and units used by each program; response at 4556 nm is not the static limit.
public_data_status: Available at task start; retrospective observations. No blind release mechanism is claimed.
